skill.summary: Search the web using Perplexity's Search API for ranked, real-time web results with advanced filtering. Use when you need to search for current information, market research, trending topics, or when Brave Search is unavailable. Supports recency filtering (day/week/month/year) and returns structured results with titles, URLs, and snippets.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: Clean OpenClaw search skill using Perplexity Search API. Features web search with recency filtering, zero dependencies, and security hardening.
